text: Ñalnde yedduɓe ɓen yi'oyta Malaa'ikaaɓe ɓen tuma ɓe maayata, e ka Barjaku kadi, e ka Immital maɓɓe, e tuma ɓe soggetee ka hasboore, e tuma ɓe naatata ka Yiite haray welo-welo alaana ɓe e ɗeen darorde ɗon. No seedi e gomɗinɓe ɓen, Malaa'ikaaɓe ɓen wi'ana ɓe: No harmi, no harminaa e dow mooɗon welo-welo ngon immorde ka Alla.
